replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. Since my high neuroticism, complex equations and problem-solving can make me anxious, but I manage by taking breaks and seeking help when needed.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tutors to practice algebra. It was helpful for step-by-step explanations, but I still prefer human teachers for complex topics.
